title: security(components): the ui 'html' renderer injects schema.html unsanitised — the spec declares no html component; retire the type
body:
## 维护者速读

`packages/components/src/renderers/basic/html.tsx` 把元数据里的 `schema.html` 原样 `dangerouslySetInnerHTML`，没有任何消毒；该类型已注册、objectui 自己的 zod 面接受、console 构建产物的 `sdui.manifest.json` 里也有。spec **没有** `html` 组件（spec 的 `kind: 'html'` 页面是受限 JSX，由 sdui-parser 编译，且 sdui-parser 明确禁止 `dangerouslySetInnerHTML`）。于是任何能写元数据的人（北极星里作者是 AI）都能把原始 HTML 放进每个浏览者的页面——存储型 XSS，信任边界是「元数据作者」。按契约优先，建议退役而不是加消毒。

## Measured (2026-10-24, HEAD 7981384)

- Sink: `ComponentRegistry.register('html', …)` in `packages/components/src/renderers/basic/html.tsx` renders a div whose inner HTML is `schema.html`; the registration's own `inputs` row describes it as "Raw HTML content". `HtmlSchema` lives in `packages/types/src/data-display.ts`.
- Reachable: imported by `packages/components/src/renderers/basic/index.ts` (the line `import './html';`); admitted by `packages/types/src/zod/data-display.zod.ts` (`type: z.literal('html')`); present in the built console's `apps/console/dist/sdui.manifest.json`.
- No sanitiser on the path: `DOMPurify` is imported by 0 source files (the root `dompurify` override only serves a transitive dependency); PR objectui#13431 added rehype-sanitize to fields' html / richtext values and did not touch this renderer.
- Spec side: `packages/spec/src/ui/component.zod.ts` mentions `html` only in prose; the page-level `kind: 'html'` (`page.zod.ts`, `COMPILED_PAGE_KINDS`) is constrained JSX compiled by `@objectstack/sdui-parser`, whose `FORBIDDEN_ATTRS` in `packages/sdui-parser/src/parse.ts` includes `dangerouslySetInnerHTML`.
- Session token lives in localStorage (`packages/auth/src/createAuthClient.ts`, `TOKEN_STORAGE_KEY`), which makes a script injection a session-theft primitive.
- Issue dump search for `dangerouslySetInnerHTML|XSS|sanitiz` over 2,012 cards: only objectui#13431 (fields). Other `dangerouslySetInnerHTML` sites were read and are not metadata-driven raw strings (print stylesheet, scoped CSS, shiki output, mermaid SVG, an escaped hand-rolled markdown preview).

## Recommendation

- [ ] Retire the `html` component type: remove the registration, `HtmlSchema`, its zod row and docs; rich HTML belongs to the already-sanitised fields path or to a `kind: 'html'` page. One `!` changeset for components and types.
- [ ] If a production consumer of `type: 'html'` turns up (未实测: external npm consumers), the fallback is sanitising through the same rehype-sanitize schema fields use — but that keeps an objectui-only component the spec does not know.

Effort S. Priority input: NORTH-STAR says security and data integrity never wait for the path.

Refs: objectui#13431.

Filed by the read-only whole-repo review session `https://claude.ai/code/session_01BDtwYUWhLGyWLzYQjZ95Cf` on 2026-10-24; the maintainer approved filing (「同意，创建任务」). Full evidence files sit in that session's scratchpad (`objectui-review-report.md`, `findings-*.md`). ⛔ Not a claim; for triage to grade and route.
